representation_contract.name: SHARED_DAG_FACTOR_SET_WITH_LOCAL_BUCKET_EXISTENTIAL_ELIMINATION
representation_contract.initial_factors: one exact R18 OR-DAG root per frozen CNF clause; do not globally conjoin the 287 clauses
representation_contract.factor_set_canonicalization: factor roots are deduplicated by root id; TRUE factors are dropped; one FALSE factor makes the entire factor conjunction FALSE
representation_contract.frozen_elimination_order: exact sealed r18.elimination_order(frame,bridge) on the original W05 frame
representation_contract.bucket_rule: for variable x collect exactly the current factors whose DAG support contains x; factors without x are untouched
representation_contract.bucket_operation: locally AND only bucket roots with sealed R18 Dag.AND, then apply exactly one sealed R18 Dag.exists(local_root,x), replace the whole bucket by that quantified root
representation_contract.absent_variable_rule: if no current factor support contains x, record a no-op elimination step and continue
representation_contract.multi_root_gc: after each bucket replacement, garbage-collect nodes unreachable from any retained factor root; reachability semantics identical to R18 single-root GC but rooted at the entire factor set
representation_contract.terminal_interface: after the frozen order, every retained factor support must be a subset of frozen bridge B; candidate bridge function is conjunction of retained factor roots without materializing a global conjunction

exactness_identity: For current factor conjunction H=AND_i F_i and variable x, partition factors into bucket X={F_i:x in supp(F_i)} and rest R. Since factors in R do not depend on x, exists_x H = (exists_x AND_{F in X} F) AND (AND_{F in R} F). Repeating this identity over the frozen original-internal order preserves I_F(B)=exists_Y F(Y,B).

post_terminal_verifier.candidate_evaluation: directly evaluate every retained factor root under bridge assignment and AND the results; never materialize a global candidate DAG
post_terminal_verifier.MATCH: allowed sets identical; FP=0; FN=0; truth hashes equal
post_terminal_verifier.MISMATCH: preserve semantic counterexample; do not tune R27

promotion_rule: Only exact exposed-W05 semantic MATCH within the unchanged envelope may authorize byte-freezing R27 for post-discovery controls on already exposed R19-W06..W08. Fresh unseen testing requires a later new freeze and selector.
claim_ceiling: R27 tests one exposed world and one exact factor-set composition operator. It does not establish polynomial bucket width, arbitrary-CNF totality, SAT-in-P, P=NP, or P!=NP.
